name: Raccoon Creek Benefit Fund
summary: Consent-decree settlement fund for nonprofits and conservation districts doing stream restoration, riparian planting, acid mine drainage treatment and land protection in the Raccoon Creek watershed, Pennsylvania.

amount.note: No set minimum or maximum; larger requests welcome after talking to FPW

reporting: Final reporting is mandatory for all grants.

applicant_types.quote: FPW awards grants to nonprofit organizations and government entities such as conservation districts.

geography.quote: projects must occur in the Raccoon Creek watershed or proximate locations.

access.quote: Letters of intent (LOIs) will be reviewed on a rolling basis; however, full proposals will be reviewed twice a year, in the spring and fall.

reporting.quote: Final reporting is mandatory for all grants

amount.quote: While there are no minimum and maximum award sizes, we anticipate funding projects in the $5,000 to $50,000 range.

pool.quote: This grant program currently has $475,000 available for projects

window.quote: full proposals will be reviewed twice a year, in the spring and fall.
